samples.summary: Todo checklist understates completed work: only step 1 is checked, but steps 2–7 (comment-ops.ts + comments.controller.ts, slide-ops.ts + slides.controller.ts, tab-ops.ts deletions/move/duplicate + tabs.controller.ts, worksheet-images.ts + controller, board-tree.ts, and the CLI's comments/slides/tabs/images/board commands) are all already present and functioning in the working tree of this change.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260904-class-b-backend-endpoints-todo.md lines 26-52 list steps 2-8 as `[ ]` (unchecked), but `packages/backend/src/yorkie/comment-ops.ts`, `packages/backend/src/api/v1/comments.controller.ts`, `packages/backend/src/api/v1/slides.controller.ts` (with `layouts`/add/duplicate/delete/move), `packages/backend/src/api/v1/tabs.controller.ts` (delete/move/duplicate), `packages/backend/src/yorkie/worksheet-images.ts`, `packages/backend/src/yorkie/board-tree.ts`, and `packages/cli/src/commands/comments.ts`, `sheets-images.ts`, `board.ts`, `tabs.ts`, `slides-edit.ts` all already exist with the described functionality, and the CLI's `schema/registry.ts` already registers `comments.list/add/reply/resolve/unresolve/delete/delete-comment`, `slides.layouts`, and board content entries. A reader relying on the todo's checklist state would believe most of the class-B work is still outstanding when it has, in fact, shipped in this same change.
